references.text: Mentions Og, king of Bashan, and his kingdom with the cities of Ashtaroth and Edrei.
Describes the beginning of the battle against Og, king of Bashan, at Edrei.
Mentions sixty cities throughout the region of Argob, Og's kingdom in Bashan.
Describes the allocation of Bashan and Gilead to the half-tribe of Manasseh.
Tells of the victory over Og, king of Bashan, and the conquest of his cities and land.
Mentions the kingdom of Og, king of Bashan, which was given to the tribes of Gad, Reuben, and Manasseh.
Describes Og's kingdom that ruled from Ashtaroth and Edrei over all Bashan.
Mentions Gilead and the entire kingdom of Og in Bashan with the cities of Ashtaroth and Edrei.
Mentions Salcah as one of the border towns in Bashan under Solomon's officials.
